paragraphs.text: Prompt optimizer for the DSH composer: one star button, two sliders, model switching, 11 toggleable
rules. 星芒 · DSH 提示词一键优化插件。
Starlight · one-click prompt optimizer
DSH plugin · by Starlit Sky · Changelog
A **circular four-pointed-star** button on the **left** of the DSH composer, wearing a hairline ring
and soft glow so it lifts off the toolbar. One click turns your draft into a clearer, more complete
, more executable prompt.
Model, strength, detail, language and rules are all editable, each in its own place: the **model com
es first**, **strength and detail are two sliders**, and the 11 built-in rules toggle individually —
custom rules on top. All of it lives on a **dedicated settings page** (Settings → Starlight), while
the popover keeps only the four controls you reach for.
> A standalone plugin. No DSH source edits, no `index.html` injection, two official slot seats.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features
| ✦ One click | Read the draft → rewrite with the rule set → atomic write-back, caret returned to th

e editor |
| ✦ Editable rules | 11 built-in rules grouped as *structure / expression quality / fidel

ity guards*, each toggleable, with per-group counters and all-on / all-off |
| ✦ Custom rules | One

per line; they outrank the built-in rules |
| 🎚 **Slider-first** | **Strength** (5 stops: minimal →
light → balanced → strong → rebuild) and **Detail** (3 stops) are sliders with real stops, not three

values padded into five |
| ✦ Scenario | General / engineering / writing / analysis, folded under “

More” |
| ✦ Output language | Follow the draft / force Chinese / force English |
| 🎛 **Model switchi
ng** | Pick any model the host advertises (`provider · friendly name`), or keep the default "follow

the session model". Affects only Starlight's side call, never your session model |
| ⚙ **Settings pa
ge** | **Settings → Starlight**: switch, shape, all 11 rules, custom rules, model, temperature / tok

en cap / timeout — in one place |
| ↩ Undo | A toast after each run restores the previous draft in o

ne click |
| ⌨ Shortcut | `Ctrl/⌘ + Shift + O` inside the composer |
| 🛟 Local fallback | No model,

timeout or offline → mechanical tidy-up plus a stated reason, never a silent failure |
| 🖱 Right-cli
ck / long-press | Opens the compact rules popover (520 ms for touch); the settings page has everythi
-press | Opens the compact rules popover (520 ms for touch); the settings page has everything else |
**It never** sends messages, creates turns, writes to the session log, or touches other plugins' set
ever** sends messages, creates turns, writes to the session log, or touches other plugins' settings.
### What it looks like
Popover (right-click / long-press) — four controls by default, everything else folded into “More”:
Model list expanded (the same row + chevron as DSH's native picker, no OS dropdown):
"More" expanded — only the scenario switch and the master toggle; rules, custom rules and advanced l
ive in the settings window:
The gear in the popover opens a **standalone settings window** — the same config as Settings → Starl
ight, 760px wide, rules in two columns:
Settings page (Settings → Starlight) — the **same content** as the settings window: model first, the
n sliders, language, scenario, rules, custom rules and advanced:
> Both are rendered from the **real components** by `node tools/make-shots.mjs` (jsdom + React + hea
dless Edge), not hand-drawn mockups — they cannot drift from the shipped UI.
### Interface details
[该节后续省略]
### What the settings page holds
Navigation id: `starlight`.
| Section | Contents |

| Switch | Master switch; off ⇒ the button only tidies formatting and never calls a model |
| Rewrit
e force | **Strength** (5-stop slider) + **Detail** (3-stop slider) + language (3 segments); the cur

rent stop's explanation sits under each slider |
| Rules | Folded by default: scenario chips, 11 gro

uped checkboxes with per-group counters, all-on / all-off, master switch |
| Custom rules | Folded:

multi-line textarea, one rule per line |
| Model (first) | Dropdown to switch models (`Follow the se

ssion model` or any advertised model), with `⟳` to re-read the catalog |
| Advanced | Folded: `maxTo

kens` / `temperature` / `timeoutMs` as sliders, plus the config-file path |
| Config file | Absolute
path of the config document; a clear reason plus **Retry** when the host is unreachable |
The footer shows `Unsaved changes` (amber) / `Saved` / `In sync with disk`, with **Restore defaults*
* and **Save** (disabled while clean).
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Deliberate choices:
- **Rules live host-side, once.** The browser half is a classic script wrapped by DSH's `__ModuleLoa
der__`, so it cannot `import` local modules; the catalog always comes from `/manifest`. No two drift

ing copies.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
Verified against **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` and `-settings-genera
l` inside `app.asar`):
| Interface used | Source |

| `conversation.input.left` slot (`kind: list`, `scope: session`) | `registerComposerBar()` |
| `set
tings.section` slot (`kind: list`, `scope: root`; entries carry `id` / `order` / `label()`) | `Setti

ngsRoot` in `dsh-client-ui-settings-general` |
| `ctx.slots.inject()` / `slots.register()` / `inject

(sessionId)` | `dsh-client-ui-slots` |
| `conversation.input.for(actx)`, `.shell(sessionId)`, `.setD

raft()`, `.state` snapshot | `SessionInputShell` / `InputHub` |
| `session.projections.faceOf('model

Selection')` | `SessionInputShell.submissionState()` |
| `ctx.llm.listProviders()` / `.listModels(pr

ovider)` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` |
| `ctx.llm.stream({ provider, model, messages, system, maxTokens

, signal })` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` |
| `ctx.webServer.register({ kind, path, handler })` | `@deep

seek-ai/dsh-host-webserver` |
| `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-def

ost-webserver` |
| `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model` |
Every possibly-absent service (`llm`, `agentDefaultModel`, `connection`, `sessions`, `conversation`)
is read lazily through `ctx.get()` inside `try/catch`: a missing one only degrades a feature — it n
ever parks the plugin in PENDING and never makes the composer disappear. A missing `settings.section
` slot (older host) simply means no settings page; the button keeps working.
